newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads five Nigerians, one Afghan.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads five Nigerians, one Afghan.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded five Nigerians for an armed bank robbery and an Afghan man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, bringing to 16 the number of executions in Saudi Arabia this month.
A Saudi Interior Ministry statement read on state-run television said five men were beheaded in the Red Sea port city of Jeddah after a court found them guilty of robbing a bank in the same area.
It said the five used arms to control the bank's employees and fled in a stolen car after locking them up.
The ministry gave no further details.

Earlier, the ministry said in a statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency that an Afghan man was executed in the capital Riyadh after a court found him guilty of smuggling heroin into the kingdom.
The executions raised to 39 the number of people put to death this year in Saudi Arabia, which enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
